name: sk-sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A compact trend line for cards and rows — no axes, no legend, no chart framework. Optional gradient fill and a highlighted last point.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKSparkline(values: [3, 5, 4, 8, 7, 11])
SKSparkline(values: revenue, tint: .green, showsFill: true)
